task: Close Provider availability evidence and implement tiered validation, reuse and affected-test selection

rows.requirement: For the current release, run endpoint-scoped reasoning, tool and vision capability probes through the typed Provider request profiles against one configured, actively used remote Provider representative; unconfigured Provider adapters are outside this release acceptance scope.
runtime_scenarios: Replay the capability matrix against the configured Volcengine Coding Plan connection using the credential already stored out of band under ~/.elfienest.
The Volcengine connection passed all 8 active model text checks; each model then ran tools, vision and reasoning probes with exact endpoint evidence.
The release representative rule leaves unconfigured Provider adapters deferred until they become configured and actively used.
platform_conditions: Real Provider subscription and credential supplied outside the repository
evidence: artifact: $ELFIE_HOME/configs/providers.yaml; 8 exact endpoint records now carry per-model capability evidence; no secrets were read into the repository

review: live Volcengine evidence shows tools and reasoning verified on all 8 models, vision unsupported on 7 models, and vision accepted but not yet verified on deepseek-v4-pro; this satisfies the representative-Provider release gate

rows.requirement: When the serving Food/model projection changes during a validation run, the in-flight run must stop using the stale generation and the next generation must be eligible for validation.
runtime_scenarios: Run a replayable scheduler scenario with a mutable ServingFoodIndex, a delayed validation callback and a Food edit that changes the generation; verify stale queued channels are cancelled and the next generation runs.
platform_conditions: CPython 3.9.25, isolated temporary data root and SQLite report database
evidence: review: old generation attempts only the in-flight channel, cancels remaining stale channels, and the changed generation is validated on the next run

rows.requirement: Two real validation workers sharing one report database must never execute the same validation or retention lease concurrently.
runtime_scenarios: Run two separate POSIX Worker processes against one temporary SQLite report database and record the winner/loser for both model-validation and retention leases.
platform_conditions: CPython 3.9.25 on macOS/POSIX, multiprocessing fork context and SQLite WAL-capable temporary filesystem
evidence: review: two independent processes shared one ReportRepository database; exactly one process ran each leased operation

rows.requirement: Classify changed paths and automatically select the smallest safe validation tier, escalating unknown and governance-sensitive changes.

evidence: artifact: plan output selected Provider tests and escalated governance changes
